document: AMD AXI DMA LogiCORE IP Product Guide PG021, version 7.1, 2025-06-24
derived_rules: CPU may process and reallocate only descriptors with Completed set.
Clear completion before advancing TAILDESC to the final reallocated descriptor.
Updating TAILDESC resumes a paused engine or changes its future pause point.
RX descriptor completion, transferred bytes, SOP and EOP establish each completed packet.

implementation.reallocation: Only after successful copy_to_user; dma_rmb before payload reads; dma_wmb before tail update
implementation.full_ring: Explicit ENOBUFS terminal state with readable validated prefix; never overwrite unread data
implementation.normal_stop: PL boundary stop, drain final DMA descriptor, then quiesce DMA without producer ABORT
implementation.failure_scope: Committed DMA prefix is distinct from SD fsync durability

acceptance_boundary: RTL simulation, static ABI checks and kernel compilation do not establish physical DMA ordering or SD sustained-write performance.
